# `Q-5-59` — Invalid Social Metadata Option

> An `open-graph` or `twitter-card` setting, or one of their options, has the wrong type and is ignored.

## What this means

`open-graph` and `twitter-card` take `true`, `false`, or a map of
options, and each option Quarto reads has a type: text for `title`,
`description`, `image`, `image-alt`, `locale`, `site-name`, `creator`,
`site` and `card-style`, and a whole number for `image-width` and
`image-height`.

A value of another type is ignored: an `open-graph` setting that is
neither a boolean nor a map leaves the provider configured as if the
key were absent, and an ill-typed option falls back to its default.
The rest of the page renders normally.

Keys Quarto doesn't read are ignored without a warning.

## Why this happens

A list where text belongs, or a word where a number belongs:

```yaml
website:
  open-graph:
    title: [My, Site]      # a list, not text
    image-width: wide      # not a number
  twitter-card: 3          # neither true/false nor a map
```

## How to fix

Write the value as the type the option expects:

```yaml
website:
  open-graph:
    title: My Site
    image-width: 1200
  twitter-card: true
```

See [Social metadata](../../guides/projects/social-metadata.qmd) for
every option.
